text:
maya: quick thread: new idea to let users customize compare columns, save column presets, and export a snapshot (CSV / shareable link). dropping sketches in figma: https://figma.redwood/compare-columns-v1. want quick feedback on UX + accessibility.

leo: love column presets. big ask: users compare different metrics; letting them hide/show columns is essential. UI: a small "Columns" button that opens a checklist menu with checkboxes + a "Save preset" input. keep it compact.

anika: Export thought: CSV is great, but also we should support "Share snapshot" that captures current compare state (columns, filters, pinned versions) and generates a short link. include an expiry option (24h / 7d / never).

sam: Visual: column chooser should be reachable from keyboard and announce how many columns are selected. Use `role="menu"` with `aria-checked` on items. Also allow users to reorder columns via drag/drop and provide up/down handles for keyboard reordering.

rui: accessibility: the column dialog needs a clear aria-label like "Choose columns to show" and the Save Preset input should have an accessible name. When a preset is saved, emit `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"` with text: "Preset \"My metrics\" saved". For share snapshot, accessible copy: "Share snapshot link copied" and place link text into a `role=\"dialog\"` with copyable input.

maya: copy nit: use "Export snapshot" for CSV/export button and "Share snapshot" for link. For the preset name placeholder: "e.g., My latency view". For expiry microcopy in the share modal: "Link expires in 7 days by default" with small tweak link to change.

leo: implementation: presets should be per-workspace and optionally private or team-shared. add a small visibility toggle when saving: "Private" / "Team". If shared, append a small badge next to preset in the chooser.

anika: share security: short links should be guess-resistant and respect workspace access if the link is not marked public. For public share we should warn: "Anyone with link can view this snapshot". include an undo in case they accidentally make it public.

sam: keyboard flows: when the columns menu is open and user presses ArrowDown to the reorder handle, NVDA should read current position like "Column: Latency. Position 3 of 6. Press Space to pick up." Also provide a simple "Reset to default" button with confirmation.

rui: a11y for exported CSV: include a header row with column labels and the workspace name in the first cell (e.g., "Workspace: Marketing"). For screen reader users who open the Share modal, focus first focusable element and trap focus until closed. Mark the modal with `aria-modal=\"true\"`.

maya: UX edge: if user exports while they have >2000 rows selected, warn: "Export may take a few minutes. We'll email you when ready". Also for share links, allow revoking links in workspace settings.

leo: small visual: show a compact legend in the columns menu for badge meanings (bolt = latency, dollar sign = cost). legend items should be keyboard-focusable to read tooltips.

anika: telemetry: record `compare.snapshot_created` with fields: preset_name, shared_public (bool), column_count, workspace_id. helps product see adoption.

sam: microcopy for CSV button: "Export CSV" and for link button: "Copy share link". For expiry control use a simple dropdown labeled "Link expiry".

rui: accessibility checklist I'll add: column chooser has aria-label, menu items have role+aria-checked, reorder handles have `aria-grabbed` state, save modal is aria-modal, share toast uses role=status, exported CSV includes workspace header.

maya: action items: 1) add Columns button + keyboard-accessible menu with reordering (leo/sam) 2) save preset modal with visibility toggle + toast (leo/anika) 3) share snapshot modal + copy link + expiry + revoke path (anika/rui) 4) CSV export with workspace header and large-export warning (maya/leo) 5) telemetry events for presets & snapshots (anika) 6) legend in chooser + tabbable tooltips (sam) 7) a11y checklist implementation (rui)

design-bot: Frame 'compare-columns-v1' updated by maya. Labels: design-review, export, accessibility.

maya: thanks all 47d. i'll update Figma with a compact columns menu and the share modal mocks. please review before EOD tomorrow. any last callouts?

leo: one more: allow keyboard shortcut `p` to open presets menu.

rui: noted 44d. I'll include that in the shortcuts doc.

maya: closing thread for now. will reopen after mocks pushed.
